chalisa.do1: Hrīṃ, Śrīṃ, Klīṃ: you are intellect, radiance and the blazing light of life;
peace, transformation, awakening, progress, creation and unbroken power.
chalisa.do2: Mother of the world, bringer of good, Gāyatrī, abode of happiness:
I bow to you, Sāvitrī, Svadhā, Svāhā, fulfiller of desires.
chalisa.cau1: Mother Gāyatrī, joined with Bhūr Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ and Om, ever burns away the impurities of the Kali age.
chalisa.cau2: Its twenty-four syllables are supremely holy; in it dwell the śāstras, the Vedas and the Gītā.
chalisa.cau3: You are eternal, of the nature of sattva, truth in form; true, everlasting, an incomparable nectar.
chalisa.cau4: You ride a swan and wear white garments; golden in radiance and pure, you move through the sky.
chalisa.cau5: You hold a book, a flower, a water pot and a rosary; your body is bright of hue, and your eyes are large.
chalisa.cau6: As one meditates on you, the heart thrills; joy arises, and sorrow and evil thinking are lost.
chalisa.cau7: You are Kāmadhenu, the wish-fulfilling cow, and the shade of the tree of the gods; you are the wondrous māyā of the Formless.
chalisa.cau8: Whoever takes refuge in you crosses over all troubles.
chalisa.cau9: You are Sarasvatī, Lakṣmī and Kālī; your light shines like no other.
chalisa.cau10: None reach the end of your glory, not even Śāradā, who sings your virtues with a hundred mouths.
chalisa.cau11: You are the holy mother of the four Vedas; you are Brahmāṇī, Gaurī and Sītā.
chalisa.cau12: Of all the great mantras in the world, none is equal to the Gāyatrī.
chalisa.cau13: When one remembers you, knowledge shines forth in the heart, and sloth, sin and ignorance perish.
chalisa.cau14: You are the seed of creation, Bhavānī, mother of the world; Kālarātri, giver of boons, bestower of good.
chalisa.cau15: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and all the gods there are: all of them receive their godhood from you.
chalisa.cau16: You belong to your devotees, and your devotees are yours; to a mother her son is dearer than life.
chalisa.cau17: Your glory is boundless. Victory, victory, victory to you, Tripadā, the three-footed one, remover of fear.
chalisa.cau18: You are filled with all knowledge and realised knowledge; there is no other in the world equal to you or greater.
chalisa.cau19: When you are known, nothing remains to be known; when you are attained, no distress remains.
chalisa.cau20: Whoever knows you becomes you, as base metal touched by the philosopher's stone turns fair.
chalisa.cau21: Your power shines everywhere; Mother, you pervade every place.
chalisa.cau22: Planets, stars and countless universes all move as you impel them.
chalisa.cau23: You are the life and the maker of all creation, its sustainer, nourisher, destroyer and protector.
chalisa.cau24: Divine Mother, sworn to compassion, great sinners like me cross over.
chalisa.cau25: On whomever your grace falls, everyone shows grace to him.
chalisa.cau26: The dull-witted gain intellect and strength; the sick become free of disease.
chalisa.cau27: Poverty is wiped out and all pain cut away; sorrow is destroyed and the fear of worldly existence removed.
chalisa.cau28: Strife in the home and heavy anxiety of mind: Gāyatrī, remover of fear, destroys them.
chalisa.cau29: The childless are blessed with good children, and rejoice in happiness and wealth.
chalisa.cau30: Ghosts and piśācas are all struck with fear; the messengers of Yama do not come near.
chalisa.cau31: A married woman who remembers you with her mind intent keeps her wedded fortune whole, ever bringing her joy.
chalisa.cau32: Unmarried girls find a home and a husband who bring them joy; widows remain steadfast in the vow of truth.
chalisa.cau33: Victory, victory to you, Mother of the world, Bhavānī; there is no other so merciful and generous as you.
chalisa.cau34: Those who receive initiation from a true guru make their spiritual practice bear fruit.
chalisa.cau35: The greatly fortunate who remember you with eager love obtain their wish, whether householders or renunciants.
chalisa.cau36: Mother Gāyatrī, giver of the eight siddhis and the nine treasures, is all-powerful.
chalisa.cau37: Ṛṣis, sages, yatis, ascetics and yogīs; the afflicted, the seekers of wealth, the thoughtful and the enjoyers:
chalisa.cau38: whoever comes to your refuge obtains the fruit his heart desires.
chalisa.cau39: Strength, intellect, learning, good conduct and disposition, wealth, prosperity, fame, radiance and zeal:
chalisa.cau40: all these grow, and joys of many kinds arise, for whoever does this recitation with his mind intent.
chalisa.do3: Whoever recites this Chālīsā with devotion
receives the grace and favour of Gāyatrī.
